title: Information-Based Calibration of Uncertainty Quantification in Product-of-Experts Gaussian Process Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.29349v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Gaussian process (GP) regression with a single global GP (GP-glo) incurs cubic computational cost, limiting scalability to large datasets. Product-of-experts GP models (GP-pro), which combine local GP models to capture global correlations, alleviate this computational burden. However, training local experts on disjoint data subsets can lead to overestimated posterior variances. We propose GP-pro-c, a product-of-experts GP model that calibrates these variances using an information-based method. The method exploits the monotonicity and submodularity of information gain in GPs to define a calibration ratio that reduces the posterior variance of individual local GP models. We evaluate GP-pro-c using negative log-likelihood (NLL), root mean squared error (RMSE), and expected normalised calibration error (ENCE). translated_title: 基于信息论的专家乘积高斯过程模型不确定性量化校准
translated_abstract: 使用单一全局高斯过程的高斯过程回归会产生三次方级别的计算成本，限制了其在大规模数据集上的可扩展性。专家乘积高斯过程模型通过组合多个局部高斯过程模型来捕捉全局相关性，从而缓解了这一计算负担。然而，在不相交的数据子集上训练局部专家可能导致后验方差被高估。我们提出了GP-pro-c，这是一种利用基于信息的方法来校准这些方差的专家乘积高斯过程模型。该方法利用高斯过程中信息增益的单调性和次模性来定义一个校准比率，从而降低各个局部高斯过程模型的后验方差。我们使用负对数似然（NLL）、均方根误差（RMSE）和期望归一化校准误差（ENCE）对GP-pro-c进行评估。在四个合成函数和六个回归数据集上的实验表明，GP-pro-c在NLL上平均降低了2.3%……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 提出GP-pro-c模型，利用高斯过程中信息增益的单调性与次模性定义校准比率，对专家乘积高斯过程模型因数据子集独立训练而被高估的局部后验方差进行基于信息的校准，从而提升不确定性量化的准确性。
en_tdlr: GP-pro-c is proposed to calibrate the overestimated posterior variances of product-of-experts Gaussian process models via an information-based method that exploits the monotonicity and submodularity of information gain.
